payload.friendly_name: Gates that work in teammate clones and ephemeral reviewers
payload.purpose_context: Real Missions run in cloud sessions and teammate clones broke on five gates: a docs work package judged against the target branch, a lane branch that exists only on origin, an approval stamp that names an unpushed review merge, and a hex colour read as an issue number. This Mission fixes those gates so a team can carry a Mission from agreed intent to a verified result across clones.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make review, approval and consolidation work when the state lives on origin, on a topic branch, or in a reviewer that never pushes.
